notes: Supplier requests for quotation (PR_REQ_MAST / PR_REQ_DET / PR_QUOT_MAST; unused, no QUOT types configured): colour/size by group, supplier currency, generated price lines per supplier, accepted supplier cannot be removed, status 1 without suppliers (APP_RULES_SA) Wave 3b: cycle status as its legacy list (DECODE of the .fmx), RFQ / purchase-request type and supplier lists, item name on the lines.

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.QUOT_TRNS_TYPE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 7 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 13 AND T.QUOT_TRNS_TYPE IS NOT NULL) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE NVL(TP.FLAG,0) = 1 AND TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))

PR_REQ_MAST.TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 7 and trns_type = 25 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_REQ_MAST.PR_TRNS_TYPE_CODE.lov: select trns_type_code || ' - ' || desc_a d, trns_type_code r from st_trns_type where effect = 7 and trns_type = 13 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.flag = 1 and tp.password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER))) order by 2

PR_QUOT_MAST.SUPPLIER_ID.lov: select s.code || ' - ' || s.name_a d, s.code r from supplier s where nvl(s.stopflag, 0) = 0 and (nvl(to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER), 0) = 0 or (s.code >= (select max(from_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) and s.code <= (select max(to_supplier_code) from vn_supplier_password where password_number = to_number(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)))) order by 2

PR_REQ_DET.ITEM_NAME_A.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_a, i.name_e)) from st_item i where i.item_code = t.item_code and i.item_group_code = t.item_group_code)
